title: The canonical torsor map is detected on the generic fibre
statement: Let S be integral normal, c:C → S smooth with geometrically connected fibres, and Cη its cartesian generic fibre [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let G be any finite group, Z a finite etale G-torsor over Cη, π:P → C finite etale, and ψ:Z.P → P a cartesian comparison. Given any family a_g:P → P over C satisfying Z.smul(g);ψ=ψ;a_g, the canonical map coproduct_g P → P ×_C P with components (a_g,id) is an isomorphism. The family need not be assumed to satisfy unit or multiplication laws.

source.place: Tag 0BQM, proof; Tag 0EYJ, proof (extension of the action)

proof.text: Finite coproducts and pullbacks preserve finite etale structural morphisms. Set σ=coproduct_g π and ρ=pr2;π. Finite coproducts of schemes are universal colimits. Applying IsUniversalColimit.isPullback_of_isColimit_left to the cartesian comparison ψ on each summand gives a cartesian square for the coproduct comparison Ψ=coproduct_g ψ. The product comparison R is cartesian: given a map to P ×_C P and a compatible map to Cη, lift each projection uniquely through the square for ψ and pair the two lifts. Its uniqueness follows by comparing both projections.

The canonical maps t and tη commute with Ψ and R: on each summand their first projections agree by action compatibility and their second projections are both ψ. Hence tη is the restriction of t. It is invertible by Z.isIso_sigmaDesc.

Apply unique extension of generic-fibre morphisms to inv(tη), between the fibre product and coproduct. This produces b over C. The composites t;b and b;t restrict to identities. Apply uniqueness of extension of the respective identity maps to obtain t;b=id and b;t=id, exhibiting t as an isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: Expanded the generic-point full faithfulness argument and wrote the categorical assembly explicitly.

theorem GaloisCover.isIso_sigmaDesc_of_genericFibre {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsIntegral S] (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) {P : Scheme.{u}} (π : P ⟶ C)
    [IsFinite π] [Etale π] (ψ : Z.P ⟶ P) (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π π j)
    (a : G → (P ⟶ P)) (ha : ∀ g : G, a g ≫ π = π)
    (hcompat : ∀ g : G, Z.smul g ≫ ψ = ψ ≫ a g) :
    IsIso (Sigma.desc fun g : G ↦
      pullback.lift (f := π) (g := π) (a g) (𝟙 P) (by simp [ha]))
